purpose: Bind the final PC-CROP post-registration specification to exact-main evidence, classify every required contour, and establish a strict 126-criterion DoD baseline before implementation.
requiredInvariants: Registration, registration behavior and role eligibility are unchanged.
No product runtime, schema, dependency, deployment or production configuration changes are permitted in W0.
Every finding is classified as KEEP, EXTEND_EXISTING, NEW_REQUIRED, REMOVE_OR_SUPERSEDE, EXTERNAL_BLOCKER or NOT_REQUIRED.
DoD progress credits only strict PASS; PARTIAL, FAIL, EXTERNAL_BLOCKER and NOT_EVIDENCED receive zero terminal credit.
Canonical Deal, Settlement, integration, audit and outbox foundations are extended rather than duplicated.
External readiness is never inferred from mocks, skeleton adapters, UI copy or configured provider names.
Production acceptance remains REG.RU exact-revision evidence only.
acceptance: The specification hash, byte size, section range and all 126 DoD criteria are recorded.
The gap map covers schema, API, domain, UI/UX, integrations, operations and security on the exact baseline SHA.
Every DoD criterion has one strict status and a gap-map evidence reference.
The reported percentage is mechanically derived from strict PASS count without rounding up.
W1-A is bounded to Organization Capability Authority in shadow mode and explicitly excludes registration enforcement.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts only this manifest and the post-registration W0 artifacts.
